class.name: IfcStructuralReaction
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: A structural reaction is a structural activity that results from a structural action imposed to a structural item or building element. Examples are support reactions, internal forces, and deflections. HISTORY New entity in IFC 2x2. IFC 2x4 change: Inverse attribute Causes deleted; use IfcRelAssignsToProduct via HasAssignments instead. Structural reactions are grouped into IfcS
